title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements Trade-In Terms Schedule
content:
Trade-in terms on the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements** differ by deal type. They cover how long an appraisal is honored, how far the trade-in may be driven after appraisal, how quickly the store pays off the trade-in lien, and when negative equity that is not financed must be paid.

| Deal type | Appraisal honored for (calendar days after the appraisal date) | Miles the trade-in may be driven after appraisal | Store pays off the trade-in lien within (business days after delivery) | Store reimburses lender late charges caused by a late payoff | Negative equity not financed due within (calendar days after delivery) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 7 | 500 | 10 | yes | 0 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | 7 | 500 | 10 | yes | 0 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | 7 | 500 | 7 | yes | 0 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | 7 | 500 | 7 | yes | 0 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 30 | 1500 | 7 | yes | 0 |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | 10 | 1000 | 15 | yes | 30 |

Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays. A negative-equity figure of 0 days means negative equity that is not financed is due on the delivery date itself.

Hypothetical: a Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement trade-in appraised at 41200 miles may be driven up to 1000 miles, to 42200 miles, before the appraisal must be redone.
